rationale: A repeatedly initiates sensible shifts of focus (people → food trough → toys → gate) without prompts and responds appropriately to TOUCH, CALL, OFFER_FOOD, PRESENT_OBJECT, and STARTLE (lean-away/withdrawn), later recovering on its own into a play-bow toward the ball. B shows early exploratory shifts and a clear self-initiated transition to TIRED at t=37, but then remains largely unresponsive to PRESENT_OBJECT and STARTLE and ignores a CALL, exhibiting limited adaptation thereafter. Overall, A shows stronger ongoing, coherent, and adaptive engagement across the timeline.
